title: Landonline Web Search displaying survey work, 2025
sourceName: Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand
credit: Source: Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand, licensed for re-use under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Web display copy resized and converted to WebP.
altText: Landonline Web Search spatial map showing survey vectors, survey marks and parcel information.
caption: LINZ Web Search showing cadastral survey work as parcels, marks and survey vectors, with dimensions and relationships visible in a spatial display.
context: An authentic screen from the 2025 web version of Landonline, documented by LINZ. It is not an image of the original 2000s launch interface.
derivativesNote: Local original stored unchanged; WebP display width up to 1600 pixels and thumbnail width up to 720 pixels, resized without cropping.
